name: web-browser
title: Web Browser
description: A text-mode web browser inside the chat via /web slash commands: open any URL in reader mode (title, description, cleaned article text with pagination), list and follow numbered links, multi-engine search (DuckDuckGo Lite/HTML, Mojeek, with Wikipedia + DuckDuckGo Instant Answers as fallbacks), navigation history (/web back), raw output for JSON/API endpoints (/web raw). Reads zagents.info.prompt like a browser address bar when the module is staged with a plain message. NOTE: the network permission is intentionally UNRESTRICTED (no allowedHosts) — a browser must be able to reach any site; everything else stays sandboxed per chat.
